source: Live licensed TallyPrime 7.1 Silver answer to one raw gateway import of a single Payment voucher into the synthetic lab company BRIDGE AMEND LAB, debiting a ledger the book does not hold (Probe Absent Ledger 01). The request was the Import Data envelope Bridge renders for a voucher batch, sent as UTF-16LE with a BOM
transformation: none: the fixture is the response byte for byte
provenance_limit: One live import, sent once, from a licensed TallyPrime 7.1 Silver holding only two synthetic lab companies, 2 Oct 2026 18:52 UTC. Establishes that a single voucher naming a missing ledger is answered CREATED 0, ERRORS 0, EXCEPTIONS 1, every other counter 0, LASTVCHID 0, LASTMID 0, and one LINEERROR naming the ledger. Read back the same minute (observed once; the read-back responses are not committed here): neither loaded company's voucher or master mark moved, and the voucher's day held no voucher before or after. It does not establish the answer for any other cause of rejection or on any other Tally version or edition.
sensitivity_review: Synthetic lab company and synthetic ledger names only; no GSTIN, PAN, email, phone, address, URL, credentials or machine paths.
